title: The River Project
text:
In a small town near the coast, residents noticed that the local river was becoming polluted. Several families decided to take action. They organized weekly clean-up days and asked the city council to install new filters.

Within a year, the volunteer group had collected more than two tons of plastic waste. Local schools also joined the project, and children began to measure the water quality each month. Many people say the effort has brought the community closer together.

questions.text: How often did the volunteers hold clean-up days?
How much plastic waste did the volunteer group collect within a year?
What can be inferred about the residents' attitude toward the river?
options: They did not care about it
They wanted to move away from it
They wanted to build a factory near it

questions.text: Why are the children's monthly measurements important to the project?
options: They show that the project is ending
They help track whether the water is improving
They are required by the national government
They replace the work of the city council

vocabulary.definition: a person who does work without being paid
to put equipment in place so that it is ready to use
to find out the size, amount or quality of something

paragraph_translations: Sahile yakın küçük bir kasabada, sakinler yerel nehrin kirlenmekte olduğunu fark etti. Birkaç aile harekete geçmeye karar verdi. Haftalık temizlik günleri düzenlediler ve şehir meclisinden yeni filtreler kurmasını istediler.

Bir yıl içinde gönüllü grup iki tondan fazla plastik atığı topladı. Yerel okullar da projeye katıldı ve çocuklar her ay suyun kalitesini ölçmeye başladı. Birçok insan bu çabanın topluluğu birbirine daha da yaklaştırdığını söylüyor.
